name: M5.ArithmeticWorkflow.order_count_iff
statement: ∀ (N w : ℕ) (F : M5.BinaryPolynomial), 0 < N → 0 < w → F.Monic → F.coeff 0 = 1 → (0 < M5.OrderCount.C N w F ↔ (∃ S U : Finset ℕ, M5.PhysicalOrder.realizes N w F S U))
guidance: Split on F dividing cyclicModulus N. In the dividing case use27 C_positive_iff_realization and convert range subsets to element bounds in realizes. In the other case C=0; a physical realization would force F dividing cyclicModulus via gcd_dvd_right. Do not assume period divisibility in the target. Return tactic lines only, without leading by. Keep exact target unchanged.
